statement: The storage record incorrectly indicates that all photographs are backed up to the cloud, contradicting the fact that the backup was disabled two years ago and this is the only copy of these irreplaceable family memories.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "The storage record incorrectly indicates that all photographs are backed up to the cloud, contradicting" the known fact that backup was off.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
